card.name: Just before harassment or discrimination terms
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a harassment or discrimination term, such as 'being' or 'verbally' before 'harassed' and 'have been' before 'discriminated'. It appears in web text on discrimination law and survey statistics.

modes.label: Before harassed
modes.description: Adverbs or auxiliaries leading into 'harassed' in survey statistics on mistreatment.
modes.example: 84 percent of gay and transgender students report being<< verbally>> harassed, 40 percent physically harassed

modes.label: Before discriminated
modes.description: 'Been' or 'have' leading into a verb of being discriminated against.
modes.example: approximately 58% of Hoosiers have<< been>> discriminated against in their lifetime

modes.label: Civil rights law text
modes.description: Pieces of the Civil Rights Act year or the phrase 'Sexual Harassment' in employment-law lists.
modes.example: An amendment to the Civil Rights Act of 19<<6>>4 listed above.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about being forced or treated unfairly, such as 'forcing', 'forced' and 'unfair'.
card.plain: It fires on the words that lead into a mistreatment term like harassed or discriminated, before that term appears.
